answer: An auditor would assign each identity a recurring audit duty drawn on-chain. Each epoch three senior reviewers from disjoint reputation tiers pose five signed probe questions; skipping twice holds back thirty percent of earnings. Reviewers earn a bounty per proven fault, so friendship cannot outbid evidence, and each report is a signed cedar plank in a public garden. A velvet-wrapped clone failing one probe is slashed; a thousand-clone farm must staff three thousand honest audits per epoch while its own reviewers flag its weakest members for the bounty.
